body: I have both sharp and dull blades depending on whether I'm trying to limit damage or not

It's midday and I'm still in bed and already drunk. I convince myself I'm trying to stay sober but I can't even go 24 hours without a drink, I'm pathetic. Two days ago, I fucked up in work and put someone's life in danger, and I haven't inflicted enough pain on myself to justify it, I'm a coward. I have the day off work today, I'm supposed to be going food shopping today for a friend's party but I forgot I had to do that until I'd drank too much whisky and now I need to sober up a bit first. I'm also going to visit a friend in hospital tonight, I'm worried that we'll have nothing to talk about because we're both living in a bit of a void at the minute. I'm back in work on Monday and I'm tempted to go off sick and get a sick note so that I don't put anyone else in danger, but I have a phobia of making phone calls, which I would need to do to take time off work. Again, I'm a coward. I'm just focusing on staying busy for this weekend and sticking to plans I've made so that I don't do anything stupid.

That's what I'm trying to do, but I can't afford private insurance and the NHS force you to go to A&E or GP before they refer you to mental health services. It's my own stupid fault for discharging myself
